notes:
Inbound SMB lead from gaming app (mobile/social). Primary ask: low-latency real-time chat + robust abuse/spam controls. Key bullets:
- Workload: chat for live multiplayer lobbies + 1:1 DMs. Expect ~10k MAU initially, ~40 messages/user/day, goal to ramp to 50k MAU over 6 months.
- Latency targets: median <100ms in NA, <200ms in EU for streaming responses. Cost-sensitive - wants clear per-message / per-token estimate for planning.
- Moderation: must filter profanity, link spam, harassment, and bulk automated spam. Wants both real-time automated moderation + webhooks for user reports.
- Integration: prefers simple REST + SDK (hosted API). Will test streaming + moderation endpoints in POC.
- Security: SMB but asks for SOC2 evidence and audit logs; SSO for admin console useful but not blocking. No on-prem requirement; public cloud acceptable.
- Quote from ops: "We need actionable spam controls out of the box - false positives are OK to start but ops must be able to tune quickly."
- Next: send tailored hosted pricing and quickstart, schedule a 30m demo to show latency & moderation flows.
- Internal notes: likely to convert to paid if latency meets target and moderation reduces incident triage by >30%.
notes_summary: SMB gaming app exploring Redwood hosted API for low-latency chat + moderation; discovery stage, wants pricing and demo focused on streaming latency and abuse controls.
